name: Okagaki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Okagaki town emblem in navy: a stylised butterfly-like device with a pointed top.
history: Municipal flag of Okagaki, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 July 1971.

features.role: Okagaki town emblem — a stylised butterfly-like device with a pointed top
